resources.string: Border thickness (% of final short side)

Off by default. Opaque inset frame, 1–8% of final short side; no padding or aspect change. Drawn above text/PNG only in the edge strip. Title only requires Title enabled; follows its actual duration (e.g. 3/5 s), not imported intros. Whole video covers every clip. Main preview shows whole-video borders only.
Border: enable a generated title for Title only, or select Whole video. Thickness must be 1–8%.
Previous operation did not complete; see details
Static frame: trim start, crop, rotation, resize, PNG and whole-video border; not live compositing. Text, speed, audio and the intro/merge timeline are not previewed.

Crop each edge independently by 0–50%, all 0 by default. Left + right and top + bottom must each total less than 100%. Cropping 10% from each edge keeps the central 80% × 80%. Crop happens before rotation and shrinks the canvas; the gray preview frame is not exported. Arbitrary rotation or fitting intro clips may still leave borders.
Original: no resize after crop/rotation. 1080 / 720 / 480 specify FINAL output height in pixels, preserving the resulting aspect ratio. Encoder limitations may reject unsupported geometry.

Replacement music is supported: it replaces original audio across all clips, loops from the start and stops with the video. Without music, original audio is retained. Volume/mute affects original audio only, not replacement music. Long-press Select to clear music.

Generate a separate silent title before the imported intro and main video. Animation / entrance and exit, duration and appearance are independent. Dissolve fades in and out. Choose 3 or 5 seconds or enter milliseconds. Original-frame backgrounds use absolute source time, independent of main trim. Replacement music spans all clips.
Production title preview at scrubbed time

Imported intros are supported: the full intro plays at native speed after the generated title and before the edited main video, aspect-fit to the main canvas. Main-video trim, crop, rotation, text and speed do not affect it. Long-press Select to clear the intro.
Enable appended clip merge after the edited main video

Merge OFF by default. Export order is template title → imported intro → edited main → appended clips. Trim/crop/rotation/speed/text/PNG affect the main clip only; intro/appended clips are aspect-fit to the edited main canvas at native speed with original display rotation.

Main clip is always first among merge clips. Up to five appended clips (six including main), 128 MiB per video, 256 MiB aggregate source size (must be known), 120 s total timeline, 4096 px per side. Sources are read directly by default, not copied.

No PNG selected. Static PNG only, up to 8 MiB and 2048×2048. Alpha and aspect preserved. Select, then enable. Width 5–50% of final canvas. X/Y 0–100% of free space: 0 = left/top, 100 = right/bottom. PNG is above text; thumbnail previews PNG, not text/audio.
Whole presets: start offset + cut from end; too-short inputs rejected. Assets copied durably. Input, merge list, software AVC and output folder remain current/global.

Off by default. Try enabling this if exported colors look wrong; software encoding is slower. Ordinary exports have no in-app processing time limit; cancel manually. System interruptions, insufficient storage or codec errors can still cause failure; self-tests retain diagnostic deadlines. Keeps the selected size and frame rate, and fails explicitly if unsupported: no hardware fallback or automatic downsizing. Compatibility mode does not support HDR. The setting is saved for subsequent exports, merges and full self-tests; correct colors are not guaranteed on every device.
Output videos: public Movies root on Android 10+. Android 6–9: choose a writable video directory. Diagnostic TXT destination is separate.
